review.rationale: Stationary source algebra, full local drift/Hurwitz certificate and conditional transfer inverse reviewed with exact controls. Follow-up review distinguishes frequency sweeps, fitted/derived calibration products, unresolved Fourier state provenance and fixed-point products in 17 selected schemas. Phase-free necessary-condition residual and simultaneous complex-transfer constraints checked with exact controls; shared unknown-source-scale gcd and averaging controls reviewed. Actual relative-input/transfer calibration, stationary selection and joint error packet remain unadmitted.

question: Can source feedback mimic a cubic constitutive law in a stable linear spring; when can scattering recover internal source, and can calibrated magnitude reject a locked stationary model without unique phase reconstruction or a separately known absolute source scale?

output.quantity: stable source-feedback counterexample, ideal and mismatched port inversion, source-header admission decision
output.unit: dimensional force/time-squared source algebra, dimensionless scattering and normalized exact controls; units detailed in proof
output.domain: Ordinary stationary single-mode cavity and mechanical comparator, positive rates and stiffness. Zero mechanical Duffing and zero detuning for apparent-cubic witness; full four-state linearization retained for local stability. Ideal real-port inverse distinct from complex-mismatch case.
output.accuracy: Exact rational polynomial/determinant/inverse controls and all-t>=0 positive-coefficient Hurwitz proof; no trajectory integration, measured precision or physical acceptance threshold

model.assumptions: Declared ordinary comparator, linear cavity frequency shift, single mode and stationary mean field. Stability proof is local to the stated mathematical branch, not global or a fit to the source device. Complex mismatch, Kerr and oscillating-state transfer cannot be silently dropped in physical use.
model.approximation: Source device's full Kerr/sideband model is NOT reduced to the witness as an accepted approximation. Mathematical counterexample uses a separate exact zero-Kerr/zero-Duffing ordinary model. Conditional ideal-port inverse requires real coefficient after independently supported deembedding. Shared-scale diagnostic assumes one common positive flux scale and independently known relative photon-flux settings with fixed transfer; frequency/state drift must be bounded.
model.initial_boundary: Fixed points x>=0, n=x, E^2=x*(9/16+x^2) for normalized witness a=3/4,Gamma=10,w2=c=G=1. Initial-condition transients are not simulated; Hurwitz signs certify local linear stability only.
model.drive_environment: Incident power controls cavity occupation through detuning-dependent transfer and physical force feedback. Internal occupation, external drive, measured transmission and mechanical displacement remain different quantities.
model.parameters: No apparatus values selected from response targets. Rational controls are abstract examples. Source publication/notebook parameters and published calibration methods are provenance context only, not adopted constants or independent UET predictions.

data_policy.holdout_policy: No experimental CSV numeric row parsed, decoded as a scientific record or scored. ZIP directory and three header lines for 17 selected schemas inspected, including 15 follow-up candidates; compressed prefixes/tail fetched in memory, no full archive retained or full-member CRC asserted. Derived P from n and fitted columns cannot be promoted to independent validation. Article/supplement calibration methods and figures are already exposed and cannot become blind holdout.

observation.source_state: Mechanical x,v and complex intracavity amplitude are coupled by radiation pressure; photon occupation is not incident power and is not identified as universal UET matter/Phi
observation.generated_trace: No dissipation trace used as a complete state or source. No trace feedback added to UET.
observation.carrier: Explicit stationary cavity frequency/linewidth and port transfer; optomechanical feedback changes the physical force, not merely observer metadata
observation.observer_state: Absolute gain, phase offset, delay, impedance mismatch, state/branch and positive input flux require independent same-state calibration; source supplement describes methods, not an admitted new-test packet
observation.readout: Inspected processed columns are detuning and S21 absolute. Ideal inversion requires its square and real deembedded port coefficient; complex mismatch can make even occupation multivalued. No arbitrary normalization, branch choice or clipping to rescue values.
observation.backaction: Radiation-pressure force and cavity detuning feedback included in ordinary comparator and four-state drift; not inserted as a new UET interaction
observation.frame: Declared displacement orientation and rotating-frame detuning, same consistent angular-frequency units for all rates. Abstract normalized witness separate from physical article parameter sets.
observation.time_convention: Stationary mean-field versus oscillating sideband transfer explicitly separated; source paper's time-domain protocol is not equated to static displacement records
observation.product_level: Formal proof plus source methods and curated raw header metadata, not a measured-response comparison

error_budget.unit: dimensional force/time-squared source algebra, dimensionless scattering and normalized exact controls; units detailed in proof
error_budget.numerical: Exact Fraction operations, five spectral values certify fixed-point degree-four determinants, positive polynomial coefficients establish the stated all-t>=0 certificate
error_budget.approximation: Single-mode stationary comparator, not an accepted approximation to all source-device Kerr or oscillating regimes. Local stability does not imply global attraction.
error_budget.measurement: No numerical measurements used in inference; source header/method review is not an output uncertainty budget
error_budget.systematic: Unknown run-matched gain/mismatch/phase, input attenuation transfer, Kerr, thermal/geometry effects, state dependence and branch selection remain relevant
error_budget.omissions: No unexplained physical term assigned zero. Mathematical witness explicitly zero-Kerr/zero-Duffing, distinct from actual source device.
error_budget.dependence: Future joint calibration/output sets must preserve correlations and branch alternatives; no independence, covariance or finite confidence invented
error_budget.acceptance: Formal consistency, projected-rejection algebra and header admission only; no measured threshold or global uncertainty solver. Static cubic scoring NOT_ADMITTED. Future physical comparison must bound source/readout/model effects and lock independent calibration and reserved data roles.

claim_boundary: Ordinary source-feedback counterexample and conditional readout reconstruction; not measured intrinsic nonlinearity, a UET material map, unique mechanism, SI Phi anchor or Full Topic13/Core validation. Calibration methods exist in source; complete actual new-test packet is not admitted.
next_action: Trace relative photon-flux settings, real-port transfer calibration, independently justified stationary selection and joint errors before a shared-scale diagnostic. Absolute flux/Kerr separation and raw phase are not universal prerequisites for projected model-class rejection. Unique constitutive-state reconstruction additionally requires independent branch/displacement evidence. Neither native-model reproduction nor a surviving candidate is UET validation.
